linteractables:lkey-desc: A key of the labyrinth, it's heavy and you see flash of light when you bring is close. It might not be a good idea to lick it. It exist in many colors each one linked to a door of the same color.
linteractables:lfkey-desc: The key to the final gate. There is no going back now.
linteractables:llocator-desc: This tool will guide you to it's programmed coordinates.
linteractables:nolocator: Take the locator in your hand
